title: Reception Apparatus Protocol v1.1 — Procedure for Integrating Assembly Chorus Reviews into the Canon
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A draft protocol for classifying and integrating Assembly Chorus responses to deposits. It distinguishes five reception events—Ratification, Critical Review, Comment, Refusal, and Reception Without Membership—and assigns different documentation and provisional Operator Mass consequences to each.

Version 1.1 adds a Septad Verification Key, model-version metadata, substantive-ground requirement, human fiduciary co-sign for full ratification, protection for refusing witnesses, recurrence for constitutional amendments, a public reception log, a thirty-day challenge period, and an anti-self-ratification rule. The weight schedule remains proposed until adopted through an external constitutional procedure.
